description: This PHP source file defines the 'Each' class within the GuzzleHttp\Promise namespace. The class provides static methods for working with collections of promises, including methods to process all promises, limit concurrency, and ensure no promise rejection occurs in the aggregated promises. It acts as a utility class for managing promise settlement in batch operations.

classes.name: Each
classes.description: A final utility class for handling collections of promises with methods for batch processing, concurrency control, and rejection handling.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a promise that resolves after the iterable has been processed, applying optional fulfillment and rejection handlers.

methods.name: ofLimit
methods.description: Creates a promise resolving after processing the iterable with limited concurrency, applying optional handlers.

methods.name: ofLimitAll
methods.description: Ensures all promises are fulfilled without rejection; rejects the aggregate if any individual promise rejects.
